g.text: MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets chatbook use external tools — most people never need to change anything here.
Root: local MCP serving and Hub tests. Blank
uses the serving process's current folder.
Console uses Chat scratch and admitted Workspace
1-4 mode | a add server | r refresh | t test tool | F1 help · F6 next pane · Ctrl+P palette · Ctrl+Q quit
